snippet.title: Early Access Trailer | Road to Vostok
snippet.description:
Road to Vostok is coming to Steam Early Access on April 7, 2026.

This trailer showcases new gameplay footage and early access features available at launch such as new maps, dynamic events and more.

Road to Vostok will launch at a price of 14,99€, which includes a 25% launch discount that lasts for two weeks. After two weeks, the game will be priced at 19,99€ until the full release.

Support the project and wishlist Road to Vostok now on Steam!

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1963610/Road_to_Vostok/

ROAD TO VOSTOK DISCORD SERVER
https://discord.gg/roadtovostok

WHAT IS ROAD TO VOSTOK?
Road to Vostok is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a post-apocalyptic border zone between Finland and Russia.

FOLLOW THE DEVELOPMENT
Website: https://roadtovostok.com
X / Twitter: https://x.com/roadtovostok
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/roadtovostok

DEVELOPED BY USING
Godot (Game engine): https://godotengine.org
Blender (3D modeling): https://www.blender.org
